entries.german:
Die Kreisbehörden

u.a.: Landrat Devens an Brustwassersucht infolge von Wechselfieber gestorben, 08.12.1846; Regierungsassessor v. Wrangel provisorischer Vertreter, 28.02.1847. erhält am 01.07. Urlaub wegen Krankheit; v. Rosenberg eingeführt, 03.02.1872
entries.english:
District authorities

Including: District administrator Devens died of dropsy following relapsing fever, 8 December 1846; government assessor von Wrangel served as provisional representative, 28 February 1847. He took leave on 1 July due to illness; von Rosenberg was installed on 3 February 1872.
